messages:
elaine (PM): quick postmortem follow-up. after yesterday's failover we need a short PRD update + runbook edits to lock in the guardrails we discussed. i sketched acceptance criteria below, want to align before i turn this into a formal PRD.
sam (SRE): +1. we should keep the changes minimal and operational-first. key ask: automated fallback must be deterministic and testable, not heuristics only.
jordan (eng): agreed. technical constraints: fallback plumbing should prefer 'compat-v1' quantized model, and preserve token-level attribution for billing. also need an opt-out flag per-customer.
mica (support): from support side — customers want clear messaging during failovers. add a short template for customer-facing status and a link to the runbook step they can reference.
tina (CS): for enterprise customers we need an SLA note: when fallback triggers, we must notify the contract owner within 15m and include approximate latency delta and estimated token-cost change.
elaine (PM): draft acceptance criteria (high-level):
- AC1: when latency SLO breach > 3 consecutive windows, system triggers deterministic fallback to 'compat-v1' for affected customer groups.
- AC2: fallback action logs include: trigger-reason, model-switched, affected-routes, before/after p50/p95 latency samples.
- AC3: customer-visible status update auto-posted to status page template within 10m.
- AC4: ops-runbook contains clear rollback and rehearse steps and a unit test harness to simulate a failover.
- AC5: telemetry shows no data-loss, billing attribution preserved, and an alert route to SRE+PM.

sam (SRE): tweak: AC1 should be '>= 3 consecutive 60s windows' to avoid flapping. and add a circuit-breaker: if fallback fails 2x within 30m, escalate to manual mitigation and pin to static capacity.
jordan (eng): adding engineering acceptance points:
- E-AC1: end-to-end integration test that injects synthetic 5xxs to upstream infra and validates automatic fallback within 90s.
- E-AC2: smoke test that verifies token attribution and that cached prefixes are invalidated/rehydrated safely.

mica (support): runbook snippet for status message (please copy into mobile alert):
```
STATUS: Degraded - Inference routing fallback engaged
WHAT: Routing to compat-v1 for affected customers to preserve availability
ETA: Ops investigating, next update in 15m
LINK: <runbook link>
```

elaine (PM): runbook edits i propose (short list):
- add explicit pre-checks to run before triggering fallback (verify model artifact integrity, KV cache warmup status).
- add a rehearse recipe that SRE can run weekly (scripted canary failover).
- add a post-fallback verification checklist: compare p50/p95, token counts, and sample outputs for quality drift.

sam (SRE): ops checklist idea: include a one-click escalation that does: 1) pin dedicated capacity, 2) disable autoscale burst, 3) open incident channel template. that should be part of PRD launch criteria for the guardrail feature.
jordan (eng): small implementation notes for PRD: add config knobs: 
- `fallback.policy` (values: deterministic, manual)
- `fallback.max_retries` (int)
- `fallback.notify_roles` (list)
and include an experiment plan (A/B) to measure cost delta and quality impact for 2 weeks post-rollout.
tina (CS): acceptance criteria for customers: vendor-facing doc update + runbook excerpt delivered to top 5 enterprise customers before GA. also add optional webhook hooks so customers can receive fallback events in their systems.
elaine (PM): OK next steps: i'll convert this thread into a compact PRD draft and RFC this afternoon. action owners:
- eng (jordan): prototype fallback config & integration test (ETA: 2 weeks)
- sre (sam): rehearse script + one-click escalation wiring (ETA: 1 week)
- support (mica): status templates + customer comms drafts (ETA: 3 days)
- cs (tina): customer notification plan for enterprise (ETA: 1 week)

incident-bot: incident-1820032001 has moved to status: investigating -> mitigated (note: runbook entries updated)
sam (SRE): thanks. i'll add the circuit-breaker thresholds and ensure the monitoring dashboard surfaces the pre/post metrics for the PRD review.
jordan (eng): i'll start a draft RFC with the config model and tests. will ping for review when first pass is ready.
elaine (PM): great — if nobody objects i'll create the PRD doc and link the RFC here by EOD. small ask: label all related PRs with `post-incident-guardrail` so we can track.
mica (support): no objections. will prepare the status page templates and paste into the PRD when available. :thumbsup:
tina (CS): thumbs up. thanks all.
